tool.name: ChronAeon Date
tool.description: Calibrate heterochronous molecular clocks and date MRCA
tool.command: #if $input_source.kind == "alignment": ln -s '$input_source.input_file' input.$input_source.input_file.extension && #if $input_source.input_tree: ln -s '$input_source.input_tree' input.nwk && #end if #end if @SYMLINK_WEIGHTS@ chronaeon date #if $input_source.kind == "beast": --beast '$input_source.beast' #else: --alignment input.$input_source.input_file.extension #if $input_source.input_tree: --tree input.nwk #end if #end if @DATES_METADATA@ $no_tree #if $distance_mode and $distance_mode != "auto": --distance-mode '$distance_mode' #end if #if $root_taxon: --root-taxon '$root_taxon' #end if #if $decay_gamma: --decay-gamma $decay_gamma #end if $no_optimize_root --method '$method' --clock-model '$clock_model' #if $ridge and $ridge != "auto": --ridge '$ridge' #end if --bootstrap $bootstrap --ci-method '$ci_method' $loocv #if $plot: --plot --plot-path chronaeon_date_plot.pdf #end if #if $alluvial: --alluvial --alluvial-path chronaeon_date_alluvial.png #end if #if $color_by: --color-by '$color_by' #end if @MODEL_SOURCE@ #if $max_species: --max-species $max_species #end if #if $output_json: --output chronaeon_date.json #end if #if $output_csv: --csv '$csv_output' #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input codon alignment
param.help: An in-frame codon alignment in FASTA or NEXUS format

param.name: input_tree
param.label: Phylogenetic tree (optional)
param.help: Newick or NEXUS tree. If omitted, ChronAeon will estimate one or use TN93 pairwise distances.

param.label: Skip tree (use TN93 pairwise distances)
param.help: Skip phylogenetic tree and estimate pairwise evolutionary distances directly from the alignment using TN93. Takes precedence over a provided tree — if checked, any tree input is ignored.

param.label: Distance mode
param.option: Auto (tree if provided, else latent, else TN93)

param.label: Root taxon (optional)
param.help: Reference taxon to use as ancestral root founder

param.label: Decay gamma (optional)
param.help: Exponential decay rate for time-decay weighted consensus

param.label: Disable root optimization
param.help: Disable heuristic root search when a tree is provided

param.label: Ridge regularization
param.help: 'auto' for REML estimation of Pagel's lambda, or a float value

param.label: Bootstrap resamples
param.help: Number of bootstrap resamples for empirical confidence intervals

param.label: CI method
param.help: Confidence interval calculation method for t_MRCA

param.label: Leave-one-out CV
param.help: Perform LOOCV for out-of-sample tip recovery and Jackknife root stability

param.label: Generate diagnostic figures
param.help: Generate publication-grade PDF and PNG figures

param.label: Generate alluvial plot
param.help: Generate continuous manifold alluvial / river-flow phylogeny plot

param.label: Color by metadata column
param.help: Column name in metadata to color streamlines by

param.label: Maximum taxa
param.help: Maximum number of taxa to include

tool.help:
ChronAeon Date: Heterochronous Molecular Clock & MRCA Dating ==============================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
When did the most recent common ancestor (MRCA) of a set of heterochronous sequences originate, and what is the molecular clock rate?
**How it works**
ChronAeon Date calibrates a molecular clock using serially-sampled sequences with known collection dates. It supports multiple dating estimators (OLS, PGLS), clock models (linear, spline, power-law), and confidence interval methods (Fieller, delta, Poisson, bootstrap, jackknife).
**Inputs**
- An in-frame codon alignment (FASTA or NEXUS), or a BEAST XML carrying sequences and tip dates - An optional phylogenetic tree (Newick or NEXUS; alignment input only) - Optional sampling dates (metadata CSV/TSV, Auspice JSON, or auto-extracted from headers) - Optional model weights source (Hugging Face Hub variant or local .pt file). To see available model variants, run the 'HyphAeon List Models' tool.
**Outputs**
- **JSON**: full dating results including t_MRCA, clock rate, CI, and per-taxon residuals - **CSV**: per-taxon root-to-tip distances and date predictions - **Plot (PDF)**: optional diagnostic clock scatter plot - **Alluvial (PNG)**: optional manifold alluvial phylogeny plot
